title: How to get Placed at Morgan Stanley
description: Morgan Stanley is US based in financial corporation based in New York and through its subsidiaries and affiliates, provides securities products and services to customers, including corporations, governments, financial institutions, and individuals.  Its main areas of business include Global Wealth Management, Institutional Securities, and Investment Management.   – In this video, Rishabh of Morgan Stanley talks about biggest question, viewer will be interested in knowing i.e. How to get placed in Morgan Stanley. He talks about different rounds, importance of scalability for the same and prime areas of strength for same. Check out tips in the end.  This video is also in one of the series of videos where Rishabh talks about how was the placement procedure of company, different facets of global giant company Morgan Stanley and how it has brought out the best out of him in this work experience of couple of years.
